title: What Happens When You Yawn, and Why Is It Contagious?
description:
Send this to the friend who always yawns right after you do.
Adults yawn about nine times a day, and it isn't about oxygen: tests that changed oxygen and CO2 levels didn't change yawning (Cleveland Clinic; Provine 1987). One theory is that a yawn helps cool your brain. Most kids don't catch yawns until about age four (Helt 2010), and in one study 21 of 29 dogs yawned after watching a person yawn (Joly-Mascheroni 2008). Cleveland Clinic says to talk to a healthcare provider if you have excessive yawning over a few days.
Next Body File: what happens when you get heartburn (spoiler: it's not your heart).
